title: The arena parity replays catch up with today's bots
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The three Tank Arena replays in the browser parity check were recorded before the bots learned to dodge (#37), so they showed retired behavior while still passing. They are regenerated now: only the recorded moves, outcomes and final hashes change; the seeds and match setups are the same.

Nothing else moves: no engine code, no browser build, and every pinned hash, the evolution champion, the command-line output and all 200 replay files are byte-identical. The parity check passes 7 of 7 in Node and in Chrome.
next: Refresh again whenever the scripted bots change.
